## About

I am an applied economics researcher working at the intersection of agricultural and development economics. My research focuses on technology adoption and adaptation in rural, resource-limited regions. I am currently a Research Assistant at Stanford University's Rural Education Action Program (REAP), where my work also spans early childhood development and gender inequality.
